g.text: The data model: the main tables and how they link
Every table's key is id. An arrow goes from a row to the rows that name it (one to many).

g.text: Not tables: a working copy is a folder (agents.copy and merges.kept_in name it); a recipe kept in a folder is a file in
.koloni/recipes; a team picked for a chat is a conversation_teams row with its recipe, and that row's state holds the recipe's run.
From: app/db/models.py, app/recipes.py, app/recipe_run.py, app/copies.py (6 Nov 2026)
